name.ja: ＲＧ 汎用ヒト型決戦兵器 人造人間エヴァンゲリオン初号機（夜間戦闘仕様）
name.en: RG General-purpose humanoid decisive battle weapon Android Evangelion Unit 01 (night battle specification)

description.ja: 闇 夜 を 揺 る が す 咆 哮 ―
description.en: A roar that shakes the dark night.

description.ja: ＲＧ人造人間エヴァンゲリオン初号機が夜間戦闘をイメージしたカラーリングで商品化。
description.en: The first RG Android Evangelion unit is commercialized with coloring inspired by night battles.

description.ja: 特徴的な色合いを成形色と特殊素材にて再現。印象的な劇中シーンを再現可能なエフェクト類も付属。
description.en: The characteristic colors are reproduced using molded colors and special materials. Effects that can reproduce impressive scenes from the play are also included.

description.ja: ●　夜間戦闘をイメージしたカラーリングを再現
description.en: ● Reproduces coloring inspired by night battles

description.ja: 『ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版：序』でも印象的な夜間戦闘時のカラーリングを成形色で再現。
description.en: The coloring during the night battle, which is also impressive in ``Evangelion: New Theatrical Version: Introduction'', is reproduced with molded colors.

description.ja: 紫の外装部分にはメタリック成形色を採用し、緑の外装部分は特殊素材を用いる事で、夜間での発光を再現。
description.en: The purple exterior part uses metallic molding color, and the green exterior part uses a special material to reproduce the luminescence at night.

description.ja: 特殊素材
description.en: special material

description.ja: 初号機の印象的な緑の外装部に“蓄光素材”を用いる事で、夜間での発光を再現。
description.en: By using ``phosphorescent material'' on the first model's impressive green exterior, it reproduces the luminescence at night.

description.ja: 劇中の闇夜に浮かび上がる緑の発光イメージをお楽しみいただけます。
description.en: Enjoy the green luminous image that appears in the dark night of the movie.

description.ja: ●　Ａ.Ｔ.フィールドエフェクトパーツ、専用ハンドパーツが付属
description.en: ● A.T. field effect parts and special hand parts are included.

description.ja: 劇中でも印象的なＡ.Ｔ.フィールドを引き裂くシーンを再現できるエフェクトパーツやハンドパーツが付属。
description.en: Comes with effect parts and hand parts that can reproduce the impressive scene in the movie where the A.T. field is torn apart.

description.ja: 付属武装 ： プログレッシブナイフ / パレットライフル
description.en: Attached weapons: progressive knife / pallet rifle
